blogs.title: High Amylase, Dark Fluid, or a Secret Diagnosis?
blogs.description: Analyze the alarming role of pleural fluid amylase in diagnosing Pancreatopleural Fistula. Discuss how differentiating this from Tuberculosis and Malignancy using lipase-typing and amylase levels is critical to avoid unnecessary empiric treatment and delay in care.

blogs.title: Anatomical Fishing: The Retroperitoneal Road to the Pleura
blogs.description: Explore the complex anatomic pathway that allows pancreatic fluid to track from the paraesophageal region to the pleural space. Detailed breakdown of how a distal pancreatic fistula becomes a chest pathology, emphasizing the risk of 'missing' abdominal catastrophes due to thoracic distraction.

blogs.title: The Imaging War: CT versus MRCP in PPF
blogs.description: Review the comparative utility of CT scans versus MRCP in visualizing Pancreatopleural Fistula. Highlight why relying solely on CT can miss the fistula tract, and why MRCP is the gold standard for ductal resolution in confirmed pediatric trauma cases.

blogs.title: Medical Management Success: The Conservative Path to Closure
blogs.description: Outline the specific conservative protocol (Nil per Orum, TPN, Octreotide, PERT) used for Pancreatopleural Fistula closure. Discuss patient testimonials and outcomes for medical management versus surgical intervention in pediatric trauma cases.

blogs.title: History Taking Under Pressure: When a Child Hides Accidental Trauma
blogs.description: Demystify the importance of social history in pediatric trauma cases. Analyze how distinct 'red flags' regarding patient interaction or 'bullying' contexts can clue clinicians into concealed abdominal traumas that manifest as chronic respiratory issues.
